data.one_liner: Base Modbus client package for sending requests via Serial and TCP/IP.
data.what_it_does: Provides the core implementation for Modbus clients communicating with remote Modbus servers over TCP, UDP, or Serial (ASCII/RTU) connections. Supports a wide range of element types, endianness configurations, and file records.
use_when: You need to communicate with Modbus servers/devices over TCP, UDP, or Serial in Dart or Flutter.
You require granular element definitions like registers, coils, and bit masks with custom scaling and multipliers.
avoid_when: You are building web or mobile apps that do not require industrial hardware communication protocols.
strengths: Supports multiple transport protocols via companion packages (TCP, UDP, Serial).
Comprehensive support for various Modbus element types and custom requests.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific serial libraries (like flutter_libserialport) for serial communication in Flutter/Dart.
Protocol and library limits apply for byte sizes and frame lengths.
data.setup_notes: For serial implementations in Flutter projects, you need to add the flutter_libserialport package to your own project.
